dek: Wenchang's satellite super factory passed acceptance in June and will trial-produce with a designed annual capacity of 1,000 satellites — about four months of China's entire 2025 output. GeeSpace, GalaxySpace and MinoSpace show how assembly-line manufacture is replacing the slow 'island' model.
